rules: All holder dictionaries below are copied exactly from accepted C01 research (south-africa.json, packet C01-30). Grouping them under an existing person ID does not promote dates, prove a tenure or extend an office.
Point observations are never expanded to full terms. No start or end is inferred from a successor, election, conference, resignation or death; those remain claims.

Requested windows are appearance intervals from the CLAUDE-C06-SOUTHAFRICA-01 handoff table with exclusive ends. Where a bound comes from party_leaders.json, leadership production or the handoff rather than accepted research, the person entry says so.
Real history stops at 2026-09-07; every window in this batch ends on or before 2026-09-08 (exclusive).
Heads of state, ANC presidents and deputy presidents (C01-09, C01-16, C01-21) are not in this batch: their observations are integrated with historical acceptance pending.

Image dates describe the source photograph, never the appearance window. Every age gap and every artistic extension (standing body, hands, trousers, shoes, colours added to a black-and-white photograph, civilian dress replacing a uniform) is declared in the prompt and here.

Likeness references are dated photographs of the exact person whose licence string, as stated by Commons extmetadata, matches FREE_LICENSES exactly. Ported licences, NC/ND terms, government open licences not on the list, agency or press photos and TV or video stills are rejected. Original bytes and metadata stay outside Git; the repository copy is byte-identical. Nothing was cropped, edited or labelled.
A window without a qualifying photograph is recorded as not ready. No face is invented and no other person substitutes.

Claude generates, edits and labels no image. Codex renders with its built-in image tool from the exact prompt files and input order in render-request-batch-01.md and returns the unchanged outputs; Claude then performs and records the identity, likeness, era and visual review. No review flag is true yet.
Each review batch contains at most ten people.
HTTP response header captures and pages that contain the client IP address or GeoIP fields are never copied, cited, hashed or committed.

Prompt sha256 values are over the LF bytes committed to Git (equal to `git show HEAD:<path> | sha256sum`). No .gitattributes rule covers these files yet, so a Windows checkout with core.autocrlf=true writes CRLF bytes; that hash is recorded beside each pin.
Birth dates used for age notes are general biographical knowledge with a cited source, not accepted C01 research; the registry is not edited.
